scenario.title: 討論新聞、查證消息
scenario.context: 聊新聞時，常要轉述「據說」「據報導」「一般認為」的內容，又不想把話說死。英文用 It is said that… / He is reported to… 這種「報導式被動」保持客觀距離，新聞英文裡到處都是。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Did you see the news about the new MRT line?
lines.zh: 你有看到新捷運線的新聞嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah. It's reported to be two years behind schedule.
lines.zh: 有，據報導進度落後兩年。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: And the cost is said to have doubled.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Wait, where did you read that? The article I saw said 30 percent.
lines.zh: 等等，你在哪看到的？我看的文章說是 30%。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Some post on social media. It went viral last night.
lines.zh: 社群上的某篇貼文，昨晚爆紅。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hmm, that could be clickbait. It's widely believed, but that doesn't make it true.
lines.zh: 嗯，那可能是標題黨。很多人相信，不代表它是真的。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Fair. I should check the official report.
lines.zh: 有道理，我應該去看官方報告。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did you read that columnist's hot take on remote work?
lines.zh: 你有看那位專欄作家對遠端工作的辛辣評論嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: The one who says it's killing creativity? He's known to be pretty controversial.
lines.zh: 說遠端扼殺創意那位？他是出了名的愛引戰。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: It's been suggested that he's just trying to get clicks.
lines.zh: 有人認為他只是想衝點擊。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Probably. There's so much fake news these days, it's hard to know what to trust.
lines.zh: 大概吧。現在假新聞那麼多，很難知道該信什麼。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I only trust sources that link to actual data.
lines.zh: 我只相信有附上真實數據的來源。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Same. If there's no source, I assume it's rumor.
lines.zh: 我也是。沒附來源的我都當作謠言。

patterns.en: Did you see the news about ___?
patterns.zh: 你有看到 ___ 的新聞嗎？

patterns.en: I'd take that with a grain of salt.
patterns.note: 第 89 單元會正式學這個俚語

patterns.zh: 這是還在發展中的新聞。

chinglish.wrong: The news say the MRT is late.
chinglish.right: The news says… / According to the news, …
chinglish.why: news 是不可數名詞，動詞用單數 says。

chinglish.right: I read online that… / I saw on social media that…
chinglish.why: 「從網路聽說」直翻很怪，網路上多是讀到的，用 read online。

chinglish.wrong: It is said the cost doubled already.
chinglish.right: The cost is said to have doubled.
chinglish.why: 報導式被動有兩種寫法，第二種更精簡：主詞 + is said to have + p.p.。

chinglish.right: This is fake news. / This is a fake news story.

grammar.title: It is said that / is reported to
grammar.oneLiner: 用報導式被動轉述未證實或一般的說法：It is said that… 或 主詞 + is said to + V。
whenToUse: It + be + p.p. + that 子句：It is reported that the line is delayed.
主詞 + be + p.p. + to V（同時）：The line is reported to be delayed.
主詞 + be + p.p. + to have + p.p.（更早發生）：The cost is said to have doubled.
常用動詞：say, report, believe, think, know, expect, consider, suggest（suggest 只用 It is suggested that）。
目的：保持客觀、不確定來源、或不想說是誰說的。
口語較常用：Apparently… / I heard that… / They say that…
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用「據說」「據報導」「一般認為」放在句首就好，句子本身不變。英文則有兩套結構，其中「主詞 + is said to have + p.p.」特別反直覺：講的是過去發生的事，但 said 用現在式。台灣人常寫出 It is said the cost doubled already 這種混合版。

examples.correct: It is believed that the fire started in the kitchen.
The fire is believed to have started in the kitchen.
examples.incorrect: The fire is believed to start in the kitchen yesterday.
examples.note: 過去發生用 to have + p.p.。

examples.correct: He is known to be a tough negotiator.
examples.note: 現在的狀態用 to be。

examples.correct: The new policy is expected to take effect next year.
Apparently, the CEO is stepping down.

quiz.question: It ___ that the singer is retiring.
The building is believed ___ built in the 1920s.
quiz.explanation: 過去發生的事：to have been。

quiz.question: The new MRT line is expected ___ open in 2028.
The news ___ the storm will hit tomorrow.
She is known ___ be very private.

slang.usage: 用誇張標題吸引點擊的文章或影片。

examples.en: "You won't believe what happened next!" Total clickbait.
examples.zh: 「你絕對不敢相信接下來發生什麼！」根本標題黨。

examples.en: I stopped following that page. It's all clickbait.
examples.zh: 我退追那個粉專了，全是標題黨。

slang.usage: 內容在網路上迅速大量傳播。

examples.en: Every brand wants their campaign to go viral.
examples.zh: 每個品牌都希望自己的活動爆紅。

slang.meaning: 辛辣觀點、故意引戰的看法
slang.usage: 刻意有爭議或很快下的評論。也可自嘲：Hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.

risk.note: 常用在玩笑，也用在批評評論員。

examples.en: Hot take: bubble tea is overrated.
examples.zh: 辛辣觀點：珍奶被高估了。

examples.en: Twitter is full of hot takes after every game.
examples.zh: 每場比賽後推特都是各種辛辣評論。

slang.usage: 錯誤或捏造的新聞。也常被政治人物用來攻擊不喜歡的報導。

risk.note: 帶政治色彩，開玩笑說某件事 fake news 沒問題，但討論政治時可能引起爭論。

examples.en: My uncle keeps sharing fake news in the family group.
examples.zh: 我舅舅一直在家族群組分享假新聞。

examples.en: Always check the source before you share. It could be fake news.
examples.zh: 分享前一定要查來源，可能是假新聞。

review.question: I ___ read the newspaper every morning, but now I use apps.
review.explanation: 複習第 60 單元：used to + 原形。

review.question: ___ worries me is how fast fake news spreads.
review.explanation: 複習第 59 單元：What 子句。

review.question: The article, ___ went viral, was later corrected.
review.explanation: 複習第 57 單元：非限定子句用 which。

review.question: The headline was shocking. ___, the facts were boring.
If I ___ a journalist, I'd cover the environment.
That story isn't true, ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 29 單元：否定句配肯定尾巴。

review.question: The fire ___ to have started around midnight.
review.explanation: 報導式被動：is believed to have + p.p.。
